titulo_es: Recover who said what and when

texto: **Simultaneidad con el verbo principal**: is expressed with the imperfect (**Disse che era contento**).
**Anterioridad**: is expressed with the prossimo trapassate (**Spiegò che aveva perso le chiavi**).
**Posterioridad (futuro en el pasado)**: is formulated with the condizionale passate (**Promise che avrebbe chiamato**).

filas: Disse che non poteva venire perché lavorava.
Disse che aveva già avvisato tutti i colleghi.
Disse che sarebbe arrivato con il treno successivo.

frases.it: C'è un messaggio urgente di Lorenzo nella segreteria telefonica dell'ufficio.
frases.es: Hay un mensaje urgente de Lorenzo en el contestador del despacho.
frases.en: There's an urgent message from Lorenzo in the office answering machine.
analisis: of Lorenzo in the answering machine

frases.it: Ha detto che non avrebbe fatto in tempo per la riunione delle tre perché il treno era bloccato.
frases.es: Dijo que no llegaría a tiempo para la reunión de las tres porque el tren estaba bloqueado.
frases.en: He said he wouldn't be here in time for the 3: 00 meeting because the train was blocked.
analisis: ha detto che non avrebbe fatto in tempo
He said he wouldn't make it in time.
for the meeting of the three

frases.it: Ha precisato se si sarebbe collegato via internet?
frases.en: Did you clarify if it would be online?
analisis: would be connected over the Internet

frases.it: Sì, ha promesso che ci avrebbe inviato una notifica appena possibile.
frases.es: Sí, prometió que nos enviaría una notificación tan pronto como fuera posible.
frases.en: Yeah, he promised he'd send us a notification as soon as possible.
analisis: He would send us a notification.

bloques.pregunta: Why does Claudia say «ha detto che non avrebbe fatto in tempo»?

opciones.texto: Because it expresses a later projected to the future from a past moment.
opciones.explicacion: In past indirect style, the future is expressed by passato condizionale.

opciones.texto: Because Lorenzo claims with absolute certainty that he already attended the meeting.
opciones.explicacion: He said that he would not be able to go in the face.

opciones.texto: Because the train arrived half an hour ahead of the station.
opciones.explicacion: The train was under arrest by roadblock.

bloques.frase: Lorenzo ha promesso che ci ___ un messaggio appena possibile.

opciones.explicacion: «inviare» Passate Condizionale with third-person singular break-in assistant.
It is a simple indicative future (only valid if the main verb is present).
It is prossimo trapassate (previously consumed marcaria).

bloques.pregunta: What complex structure does this question present?
bloques.frase: Ha precisato se si sarebbe collegato via internet per la riunione.

opciones.texto: Una interrogativa indirecta introducida por «se» con futuro en el pasado («si sarebbe collegato»).
opciones.explicacion: It combines indirect questioning with temporary projection of the compound conditional.

opciones.texto: A strong military order that forces all computers to turn off.
opciones.explicacion: Plan the consultation on the possibility of telematics connection.

opciones.texto: An absolute certainty that the Internet service is broken.
opciones.explicacion: Please indicate the intention to participate by digital means.

bloques.frase: Lorenzo ha detto che avrebbe chiamato subito dopo la riunione
bloques.traduccion: Lorenzo said he'd call right after the meeting.
bloques.explicacion: Future in the past by means of condizionale passato after verb of speech.

bloques.pregunta: What does the «il treno era bloccato» phrase indicate in Claudia's story?

opciones.texto: A simultaneous circumstance in the past that justifies Lorenzo's delay.
opciones.explicacion: The imperfet describes the lasting background of the unexpected.

opciones.texto: A fact that will happen the next week if it snows in the saw.
opciones.explicacion: This is the justification present at the time of the phone call.

opciones.texto: An order for passengers to come down from the wagons.

bloques.frase: I colleghi mi hanno confermato che la direttrice ___ già partita per Milano.

opciones.explicacion: Trapassate with encoded essere auxiliary in feminine singular: «era già partita».
The conditional would later mark a future, not a previous fait accompli.

bloques.pregunta: What function does the «ci» pronoun perform in this sentence?
bloques.frase: Ha promesso che ci avrebbe inviato una notifica appena possibile.

opciones.texto: It works as an indirect complement: «to us» would send us a notification.
opciones.explicacion: «Ci» replaces the group of colleagues waiting for the notice.

opciones.texto: It works as a place particle that means «in that place».
opciones.explicacion: It is not locative, but personal, first-person, plural.

opciones.texto: It works as a third person's reflexive pronoun.
opciones.explicacion: The third person's reflexive would be «si».

intro: In extensive narrations with several related interventions, the consistency of the plot depends on clearly identifying who speaks, who is addressed and what chronological order unites the facts.
